title: FactorMAD: A Multi-Agent Debate Framework Based on Large Language Models for Interpretable Stock Alpha Factor Mining
central_strategy: Initialize two LLM agents from sampled examples and different perspectives, alternate factor proposals and critiques through debate, choose existing versus newly generated seeds, convert accepted ideas into validated/corrected factor programs, admit factors through predictive-metric and correlation thresholds, and feed 100 mined factors into LR/MLP/LightGBM models and a daily equal-weight Top-50 ten-day-hold portfolio.

preserved_components: Future-VWAP label identity, alternating proposer schedule, seed-source branch, acceptance-gate shape, and equal-weight Top-k operation.
Seven explicit fail-closed findings for agent initialization, validator/correction, model training, overlapping holdings, metrics, and LLM calls.
Original publisher paper, complete result denominator, and bounded release evidence.
required_but_missing: The initial factor library, debate examples, p_seed, acceptance thresholds, comparison factors, sampling policy, seeds, and all prompts/responses.
Every generated factor program, debate/correction trace, validator implementation, maximum retries, accepted 100-factor pools, and signs.
The 5,255-stock A-share snapshot, memberships, daily price/VWAP/amount/volume rows, provider, adjustments, and calendar.
LR/MLP/LightGBM hyperparameters, fitted models, predictions, baseline configurations, and trial records.
Overlapping Top-50 sleeve treatment, transaction-cost timing, holdings, returns, metric definitions, plot arrays, and result generator.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_components_are_not_a_signal: The 13 controlled mechanics validate isolated equations and schedule shapes but include no generated factor formula, score, sign, trained prediction, or dated holding.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_local_proxy_is_excluded: The prior paper_factormad_debate_interpretable candidate is a title-derived JKP multifactor with no agents, debate, code generation, validation, A-share data, paper model, or native portfolio and has no FactorMAD lineage.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_secondary_skills_are_not_a_release: The two current exact-name repositories are unaffiliated post-paper skills/adaptations, not author code or recovered experiment artifacts.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_jkp_cannot_fill_the_gap: JKP can evaluate a disclosed factor but cannot infer the missing debate-generated programs or trained ensemble score. Selecting a generic interpretable factor would manufacture the central output.
monthly_jkp_assessment.portfolio_boundary: The daily Top-50 ten-day hold is not executable because overlapping vintages and cost application are unspecified even if scores existed.

closure_rule: Do not promote isolated equations, unaffiliated skills, title-derived JKP proxies, or generic factors to FactorMAD. Reopen for attributable generated factor programs, debate/validation traces, or a causal score/holding release.
